title: 大模型的小练习（一）：Written on the Wall II 猜想 #138 的反例
description:
大模型的小练习（一）（LLM Exercises I）。系列第二篇：三行朗顿蚂蚁的精确逃逸时间。

Explicit counterexamples to conjecture #138 of Written on the Wall II (Graffiti.pc): three trees on 18 vertices violate path(G) >= (2+u(G))*dist_min(M(G^2)); none exists with fewer vertices (exhaustive search over all unlabeled trees with 3-18 vertices). Includes self-contained verification script (Python standard library only), data, figures and a detailed note, plus a Lean 4 formalization of one of the 18-vertex witnesses (Lean 4.37.0-rc1 + Mathlib c44d09c9; one witness only, the exhaustive minimality search is not formalized).

This repository is a public record of a personal AI-assisted exploration and makes no priority claim. The first witness (a 21-vertex tree) was derived with GPT 6.2 Astra (OpenAI Codex); see PROVENANCE.md.
